Funding

Funding Programmes

We understand that embarking on the journey to building a deep-tech startup requires strategic focus & excellent resource management.

That’s why we specialise in the highest-reward European funding programs offering substantial financial support to transform your business into a viable, scalable venture.

EIC STEP Scale Up

TRL 9

The EIC STEP Scale Up is the new programme of the European Innovation Council (EIC) that provides an equity-only investment of between €10-30 million. designed to catalyse major funding rounds of ticket sizes at least 3-5 times the EIC investment. The goal of the programme is to fund rapid scale-up and commercialisation of strategic technologies, propelling Europe's economic, industrial, and technological competitiveness.

EIC

Accelerator

TRL 6-9

The EIC Accelerator is the flagship programme of the European Innovation Council (EIC) and provides grants of up to €2.5 million and an equity investment from €0.5 to €15 million. This programme is aimed at start-ups and spin-offs that require further funding to reach commercial readiness and international scale-up. Start-ups are expected to have validated a ground-breaking technology with proven product-market-fit and scale-up potential.

EIC

Transition

TRL 4-6

The EIC Transition provides grant funding of up to €2.5 million to bridge the gap between academic research and the market.  Its primary goal is to support researchers and entrepreneurial scientists explore a business case around their research and further validate the technology.

EIC

Pathfinder

TRL 1-3

The EIC Pathfinder grants up to €3 million to finance multidisciplinary early-stage research.  It encourages scientific breakthroughs that have long time horizons to reach the market. The programme hopes that by bringing together multiple academic stakeholders from different fields, new scientific discoveries will be made.

Innovation

Fund 

TRL 6-9

The Innovation Fund is one of the world’s largest funding programmes for demonstration of low-carbon technologies with an allocated budget of €40 billion from 2020 - 2030.  The fund’s objective is to co-finance the deployment of pilot and first-of-a-kind commercial projects for the pursuit of significant reduction in emissions and greenhouse gases in Europe.  The programme offers up to 60% of a project's total capital expenditure under three possible instruments - small-scale, mid-scale, and large-scale - to accommodate the varying scales of different projects and covers a wide range of innovative low-carbon technologies in areas such as energy- intensive industries, renewables, energy storage, net-zero mobility and buildings, hydrogen, and carbon capture, use and storage.

Other

Programmes

Although we intentionally specialize in our core programmes, we often work with our clients on adjacent European grant funding opportunities that support their mission.  Including (but not exclusively) programmes such as; Eurostars, the Life Programme, Eureka bilateral calls, as well as Research and Innovation Actions (IAs/RIAs) under Horizon Europe.

A new computing paradigm that harnesses the power of lasers

LightSolver is developing a groundbreaking new computing paradigm that harnesses the power of lasers to solve complex computational problems. Its' Laser Processing Unit™ (LPU) is a revolutionary innovation that outperforms traditional CPUs and GPUs for solving complex optimisation problems in supply chain management, material design, and credit risk modelling.

EIC Accelerator

€12.5 Million​

Scalable, Ultra-Efficient Electrochemical Direct Air Capture to Bridge the Global Emissions Gap

RepAir Carbon is pioneering a new era in carbon removal with its electrochemical Direct Air Capture (DAC) technology. Founded in 2020, RepAir’s fully electric system uses renewable energy and 70% less energy than traditional methods, enabling scalable and cost-effective CO₂ capture across industries and geographies. With a mission to bridge the global emissions gap, RepAir’s solution sets a new standard for sustainable and responsible carbon removal.

EIC Accelerator

€5 Million​

Redefining spectral sensing with unmatched precision and speed for both industrial and biomedical applications

FluIDect’s SpheroScan® is the first Industry 4.0-compatible sensor for microbial analysis in food production, using a novel label-free bacterial and fungal detection approach known as Fluorescent Resonator Signature (FRS). This ensures faster results to customers - under 10 minutes rather than several days - and ultra-sensitivity - detecting pathogens in media at concentrations below 1 CFU/ml.

+ More About Fluidect

EIC Accelerator

€2.5 Million​

Quantum microscope unlocking scalable, fault-tolerant chips

QuantaMap is building a breakthrough diagnostic platform for quantum chips based on patented nano-SQUID sensors. Operating at millikelvin temperatures, it delivers non-invasive, ultra-high-resolution imaging of defects and decoherence sources undetectable by existing tools. The system accelerates R&D, boosts manufacturing yield, and enables faster commercialization of reliable, scalable quantum chips
